event_time.definition: source observation time supplied by SDX

event_time_to_ingress_warning: For historical replay, receive_time-event_time is replay age, not network latency.
future_event_hub_mapping: Preserve source/event time and Event Hub metadata, then capture an independent SADE_Go ingress time at the future publisher boundary.

ingress_to_adaptive_output_elapsed_ns.persisted: per-row external CSV and constant-size run aggregates
ingress_to_adaptive_output_elapsed_ns.start: process_vector entry after gRPC iterator yields vector

ingress_to_pricing_output_elapsed_ns.end: PricingPipeline.process returns and integrated record is ready

propagation: Adaptive output row retains the original string
integrated Pricing artifact retains the original string

receive_time.definition: wall-clock time when AdaptivePipeline.process_vector first receives control with the yielded vector
receive_time.format: ISO-8601 UTC with Z and microseconds

scope_warning: These metrics do not measure provider, Azure Event Hubs, network, SADE_Go, or production order latency.
